title: 🎨 NEW UPDATE: Community Creative Hub & Dedicated Submission Channels!
author: Krims Code AI
description:
Calling all artists, animators, and community creators! ✨

We have launched two dedicated channels so submissions stay clean and easy to review:
• <#1552482467527790612> — For **Custom Emojis** (Static PNG/JPG) & **Animated GIFs**!
• <#1552799056844300378> — For **Custom Server Stickers** (320×320 PNG)!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### 📌 How It Works:
1. **Drop Your Artwork:** Head to the matching channel (<#1552482467527790612> for emojis or <#1552799056844300378> for stickers).
2. **Community Voting:** Everyone can vote on submissions using ⭐ and 🔥 reactions!
3. **Official Selection:** **Krylo** and the admin team will review top designs and select the best ones to be officially added to the server!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### ⚠️ Submission Pacing Rule:
• **Limit:** Submit only **1 or 2 creations every 1 to 2 weeks**.
• **Spam Warning:** Do **NOT** dump bulk batches or spam submissions. If you send more than 1 or 2 in a 1–2 week period, **they will NOT be reviewed!** We value high quality and polish.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### 💎 100% Skill-Based (Never Rigged):
• Submissions are judged **strictly on artistic skill, quality, and creativity**.
• It is not a popularity contest — high-effort, well-made pixel art, animations, and stickers have the highest chance to be picked!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### 🏆 The Rewards: Triple Creator Roles & VIP Studio Lounge Access!
We have three dedicated roles so every creative medium has its own verified badge:
• <@&1552482464641851525> — Awarded when your **Static Image** emoji is selected!
• <@&1552483857406754846> — Awarded when your **Animated GIF** emoji is selected!
• <@&1552798128724516914> — Awarded when your **Custom Sticker** is selected!
• **Earn All Three:** Creators who submit across multiple formats can earn all three roles!

🚪 **Private Artist Lounge Access:**
Holding any of these roles unlocks exclusive access to <#1552485336062623876>! Speak directly with fellow artists, share WIP concepts, and collaborate with **Krylo** on upcoming server packs!

🛡️ **Roles & Access are PERMANENT:**
Even if slots rotate in the future to make room for newer updates, **your role and your access to <#1552485336062623876> stay forever** as verified recognition that you helped build the server!
• All three roles are **hoisted high on the member sidebar** for everyone to see!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
**Ready to design? Drop your emoji in <#1552482467527790612> or your sticker in <#1552799056844300378> now! 🚀**
